environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB has a single listener on port 443 with a default action forwarding to the target group containing this application. No additional ALB rules or rule conditions are configured. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to the ALB and inbound 8080 from the ALB security group to the instance. The application runs as a systemd service under a dedicated 'appuser' account. No web application firewall or request inspection is attached to the ALB or CloudFront.

config.alb_rules: single default forward rule, no WAF association
config.network: public ALB, SG allows 443 inbound from any
